+def _scan_flatpak_packages(self) -> List[SoftwareInfo]:
+    """Scan packages using flatpak."""
+    results = []
+    try:
+        # Get list of installed flatpak applications
+        cmd = ['flatpak', 'list', '--app', '--columns=application,version,origin']
+        output = subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True)
+        
+        for line in output.strip().split('\n'):
+            if line:
+                parts = line.split('\t')
+                if len(parts) >= 3:
+                    name, version, origin = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
+                    license_type = self._determine_license(name, origin)
+                    if license_type == 'proprietary':
+                        results.append(SoftwareInfo(
+                            name=name,
+                            version=version,
+                            license_type=license_type,
+                            source='package_manager',
+                            package_manager='flatpak'
+                        ))
+        
+        # Also scan runtime packages
+        cmd = ['flatpak', 'list', '--runtime', '--columns=application,version,origin']
+        output = subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True)
+        
+        for line in output.strip().split('\n'):
+            if line:
+                parts = line.split('\t')
+                if len(parts) >= 3:
+                    name, version, origin = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
+                    license_type = self._determine_license(name, origin)
+                    if license_type == 'proprietary':
+                        results.append(SoftwareInfo(
+                            name=name,
+                            version=version,
+                            license_type=license_type,
+                            source='package_manager',
+                            package_manager='flatpak'
+                        ))
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+        pass
+    return results
+
 def _determine_license(self, package_name: str, maintainer_or_vendor: str) -> str:
     """Determine if a package is proprietary based on name and maintainer/vendor."""
     package_name_lower = package_name.lower()
     maintainer_lower = maintainer_or_vendor.lower()
